questions.stem:
The probability that a person completes a particular task in less than 15 minutes is 0.4

Jeffrey selects 20 people at random and asks them to complete the task. The random variable, $X$, represents the number of people who complete the task in less than 15 minutes.

parts.label: a
parts.mark_scheme:
$X \sim \mathrm{B}(20, 0.4)$ M1
$\mathrm{P}(5 \leqslant X < 8) = \mathrm{P}(X \leqslant 7) - \mathrm{P}(X \leqslant 4)$ or $0.4159 - 0.0510$ M1
$= 0.3649$ awrt 0.365 A1
Official notes (completeness pass):
- M1 Writing or using B(20, 0.4)
- M1 For writing or using $\mathrm{P}(X \leqslant 7) - \mathrm{P}(X \leqslant 4)$ or $\mathrm{P}(X = 5) + \mathrm{P}(X = 6) + \mathrm{P}(X = 7)$

parts.label: b
parts.text:
Mia takes a random sample of 140 people.
Using a normal approximation, the probability that fewer than $n$ of these 140 people complete the task in less than 15 minutes is 0.0239 to 4 decimal places.
(b) Find the value of $n$
Show your working clearly.
(6)
parts.mark_scheme:
$Y \sim \mathrm{N}(56, 33.6)$ M1A1
$\dfrac{n-0.5-"56"}{\sqrt{"33.6"}} = -1.98$ M1M1B1
$n = 45$ A1cao
Official notes (completeness pass):
- M1 For writing or using N(56,…) (May be seen in a correct standardisation)
- A1 For writing or using N(56, 33.6) (May be seen in a correct standardisation)
- M1 For standardising (allow $\pm$) using any letter, their "56" and "33.6" and putting = to z value, where $1 < |z| < 2$ Condone missing $\pm 0.5$ Condone 1 – standardisation, using any letter, their "56" and "33.6" and putting = to z value, where $1 < |z| < 2$
- M1 for using a continuity correction $-0.5$ if using n or $+0.5$ if using n – 1. Either in their standardisation or after finding n (but not both) No need to put = to z value
- B1 For using $\pm$ 1.98 or better (calc gives) 1.97914…
- A1 45 – must see a correct continuity correction or an awrt 45.02 or awrt 45.03
45 from no working is 0/6
